title: Enterprise Cloud Spanner RAG
description: Template schema for deploying high-availability, enterprise-grade RAG infrastructure on Google Cloud using Cloud Spanner Vector Search, Spanner Graph RAG, private VPC networking, and Cloud Run.

region.description: Primary GCP region for all resources.

display_name.description: Display name prefix for enterprise RAG resources.

spanner_processing_units.description: Spanner capacity in processing units (100 to 1000 PUs).

spanner_database_name.description: Database name within the Spanner instance.

enable_spanner_graph_rag.description: Create property graph tables and schema for Spanner Graph RAG.

network_name.description: Name of the dedicated enterprise VPC.

app_subnet_cidr.description: CIDR block for the application subnet.

connector_cidr.description: Dedicated /28 CIDR block for the Serverless VPC Access connector.

container_image.description: Container image URI for the FastAPI RAG microservice.

min_instances.description: Minimum instances (default 1 warm instance for enterprise SLA).

generation_model.description: Gemini model identifier for enterprise reasoning & generation.
